title: Chrome security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-133.062018: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Chrome Security Updates
leadParagraph: Google has released a security update stating that a vulnerability has been discovered in Google Chrome where an attacker could execute arbitrary code in the browser. This is caused by an out-of-bounds write to arbitrary locations.
contentHtml:
Google has released a security update stating that a vulnerability has been discovered in Google Chrome where an attacker could execute arbitrary code in the browser. This is caused by an out-of-bounds write to arbitrary locations.

Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to execute code to install programs; view, change, or delete data; or create new accounts with full user rights.

Further information on this vulnerability and how it can be mitigated can be found at https://www.cisecurity.org/advisory/a-vulnerability-in-google-chrome-could-allow-for-arbitrary-code-execution_2018-066/
